headline: Site plan for a 16-story mixed-use building and 330-space garage at 99 Lowell Street, plus a parking reduction at 223 Second Street.
summary: A subdivision at 659 Montgomery Street would create one new buildable lot. A site plan at 502 Cartier Street would add a dwelling unit to an existing three-unit building.
items: SP2026-019: site plan to redevelop the municipal parking lot at 99 Lowell Street into a 16-story mixed-use building with 196 residential units, up to 7,325 sf of commercial space, and a 330-space, 3-story parking garage
CU2026-012 (re-numbered from CU2026-013): conditional use permit at 223 Second Street for a parking reduction, with 25 spaces proposed where 110 are required
S2026-017: subdivision at 659 Montgomery Street to create one new buildable lot of 5,005 square feet, leaving the existing two-family dwelling on its own 5,005 square foot lot
SP2026-020: site plan review at 502 Cartier Street to add one dwelling unit to an existing three dwelling unit building
Review of new applications for Regional Impact, with comment from the Manchester Conservation Commission

 MANCHESTER PLANNING BOARD 
BUSINESS MEETING AGENDA 
Thursday, November 19, 2026 – 6:00 PM 
City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers 
  
I. The Chair calls the meeting to order and introduces Planning Board members and Planning 
staff. 
 
II. BUSINESS MEETING: 
 
1. SP2026-019  
Property located at 99 Lowell Street (Tax Map 10, Lot 6) , a site plan application for the 
redevelopment of the existing municipal parking lot to a mixed use 16- story building with 196 
residential units and up to 7,325 sf of commercial space on the first level, and a 330 space, 3-
story parking garage, located in the DT -2 Zoning District.  Fuss and O’Neil for the City of 
Manchester.  (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance).  
 
2. CU2026-012 (re-numbered from CU2026-013)  
Property located at 223 Second Street (Tax Map 200, Lot 18), a conditional use permit 
application for a parking reduction where 110 parking spaces are required and 25 are proposed, 
in the BC-1 Zoning District. Thomas DeBlois.  (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance).  
 
3. S2026-017  
Property located at 659 Montgomery Street (Tax Map 307, Lot 3), a subdivision application for 
the creation of one new buildable lot of 5,005 square feet, leaving the existing two-family 
dwelling on its own 5,005 square foot lot, in the MX-2 Zoning District.  Joseph M. Wichert, LLC, 
Inc. for Joseph Pantaleo. (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance).  
  
4. SP2026-020  
Property located at 502 Cartier Street (Tax Map 178, Lot 46), a site plan review application to 
add one dwelling unit to an existing three dwelling unit building in the MX -2 Zoning District., 
Joseph M. Wichert, LLC, Inc. for Providenciales, LLC c/o Corneliu Stanciu.  (Reviewed under 
current zoning ordinance).  
 
5. Review of new applications for Regional Impact and comment by the Manchester Conservation 
Commission. 
 
III. ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS: 
 
1. Review and approval of the Planning Board minutes of October 15, 2026.
